description_for_human: AI领域专家工具包平台，覆盖22个领域。搜索、复制专家prompt，一键粘贴到AI秒变专家。
description_for_model: Search expert toolkits across 22 domains. Each toolkit contains an expert prompt that transforms the AI into a domain specialist, plus authoritative data port connectors. API: GET /api/toolkits to list, GET /api/toolkits/:slug for details, POST /api/generate to create new toolkits.
